author: SHADOW
description: Staff-only Cleanup panel using Discord Components V2 Containers. Slow Mode (past 14 days) requires a unique tool password set by an admin.
install_msg: Thanks for installing CleanupUI by SHADOW! Use [p]cleanuppanel to open the staff interface. For Slow Mode (messages older than 14 days), an admin must set a unique tool password with [p]setcleanuppassword.
short: Staff cleanup panel with Containers + Slow Mode (2.5s delay, 5min auto-timeout)
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores a server-specific tool password (set by an admin) for Slow Mode access. No personal user data is stored.
